digest.component_or_area: code review trigger system / project routing configuration
propositions: The rebar project has three trace corpus bugs that trigger only through noisy-tier concurrency vocabulary (.lock, retry, Popen) absent from the committed high-precision tier, making the project overlay load-bearing for this repo.
The committed high-precision trigger tier fires on 13.3% of rebar's non-merge commits; the noisy tier adds 22.0% more, reaching 35.3% combined (measured across 300 commits).
Project-layer trigger extensions lack documented design patterns and configuration examples, preventing other projects from adding project-specific vocabulary overlays.
The project entry must define trigger_tokens (concurrency vocabulary) and applies_to (file/path globs) for the code_review.concurrency overlay in .rebar/criteria_routing.json.

Trigger behavior must change observably when the project config is active: diffs containing project-only tokens like index.lock must fire the concurrency overlay under this repo's effective routing but not under committed-only routing.
